'''Soler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] he was a councilor to Mayor [[Erkens]] of the [[Tarlam]] City. After being rescued from an [[Isotope-5 droid]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agent, Soler and Erkens asked their rescuer to cover the Tarlam shuttle pads with energy shields to prevent the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] from landing reinforcements.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Councilor Soler appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, released on [[April 9]], [[2013]].
